name: Naira approved ads · colour-coded set
how_to_use: Read the founder's verdicts in this artifact's database: collection "verdicts", one document per ad, its id the ad number ("02"), its field "verdict" either "keep" or "drop". Make an ad only when its verdict is "keep". If the verdicts cannot be read, use only ads whose status here is "approved".

Each ad is two images of one photograph. The Feed file (1080x1350, 4:5) already carries the NAIRA wordmark, the line and the name and price; use it for Facebook and Instagram Feed and Explore. The Story file (1080x1920, 9:16) is the photograph alone; use it for Stories and Reels. Never crop, retouch or add text to either file.
Give both images the ad's primary_text, headline, cta and url exactly as written here. The url opens the ad's own colour and carries its UTM tags.

Campaign: "PERF · Colour (least graphics) · Oct 2026", one ad set per ad_set value (Bracelets, Earrings, Necklaces & rings), the rows of ads.csv. The Crazy ads phase 3 ads (ids p3-01 to p3-40, their verdicts under the same ids) go in their own campaign, "PERF · Phase 3 day and night · Oct 2026", one ad set per ad_set value.
Create every campaign, ad set and ad paused, for the founder to review and switch on. Do not change any live campaign or ad.
Stock is as read from Shopify on 23 Oct 2026. Check stock again before spending on any ad with 10 units or fewer.

ads.notes: 61b: an open bypass band of thin gold wire ending in a banded tiger's eye cabochon and a faceted champagne crystal, each in its own slim bezel, as in the listing and the earlier passed plates; the ring stands upright behind three marbles that throw amber light onto the plaster. Each stone is about three quarters of a marble, true for 12 mm stones and 16 mm marbles. 61a was as faithful but spread the marbles out, with one cut by the frame edge.
